name: 06 — Gateway Monthly Token Limit (50k)
description:
Tests monthly LLM token usage enforcement.

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path
• Tenant Quota (payops_ai):
  - Monthly LLM tokens: 50,000
  - Enforcement: PostgreSQL SUM of total_tokens_in + total_tokens_out
  - Table: them.runs (WHERE completed this month)

📊 How It Works:
1. System counts tokens used this month from DB
2. If total >= 50,000 → Block new requests
3. Returns error: "monthly LLM token limit exceeded"

⚠️ Current Month Usage:
• Check DB: SELECT SUM(total_tokens_in + total_tokens_out) FROM them.runs WHERE completed_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW())
• If already > 50k → This test will fail immediately
• If < 50k → Run many requests until limit hit

🔍 Verifies:
• Token counting works
• Monthly limit enforcement
• Blocking behavior

⚠️ Note: This test depends on current month's usage.
If you've already used 50k+ tokens this month, all requests will be blocked.

✅ Purpose: Prove monthly token quota blocks requests after crossing 50k limit.
